id="ADR-0003" title="Remove plan from the built-in document types" status="Accepted" inferred=false
author="Donald Gifford" created="2026-09-14"
summary="`plan` leaves the built-in document type registry: no `PLAN` prefix, no `plan` directory, …"
context="docz shipped with six built-in types. PLAN was meant to sit between RFC (proposal) and IMP…"
decision="1. **Remove the `plan` registry entry** from `pkg/doczcore/config/doctype.go`. `DocTypeNam…"
consequences positive=3 negative=3 neutral=2
alternatives=4 open-questions=2 references=6

positive line=157
  text="**One word, one meaning.** \"Plan\" no longer names a docz type; the IMPL model's vocabulary (phases, tasks) has no built-in neighbour to collide with."

positive line=160
  text="**Less to carry.** Two templates, a registry entry, and their tests and goldens go; `docz --help` and the README stop advertising a type nobody uses."

positive line=163
  text="**Custom-type support is exercised for real.** The legacy-block fallback is the DESIGN-0006 path with a real config on it."

negative line=170
  text="**A removal from a frozen catalogue.** `config.DocTypeNames()` and `LookupDocType` are v1.0 contract; dropping a value is a breaking change, which is why it rides the v2 line (Open Question 1)."

negative line=173
  text="**Three fleet repos need a one-line config edit** or they keep a dormant custom type. Harmless, but it shows up in `docz config` output until fixed."

negative line=176
  text="**`docz template override plan` can no longer export a starting point.** A repo that wants PLAN back writes the template from scratch or copies it from git history."

neutral line=184
  text="**Sequencing with #99** (index header scaffolding) touches the same file; ordering is a rebase, not a design question."

neutral line=186
  text="**The claude-skills plugin** ships its own copy of the templates and updates on its own cadence, after v2 (Decision 5 amendment); until then its fallback can still produce a PLAN file that the CLI treats as custom."

alternative line=195 label="a" title="Keep it disabled"
  text="(status quo since v1.1.1). *Pros:* nothing to do. *Cons:* the confusion, the dead template…"

alternative line=198 label="b" title="Deprecate, then remove in v2."
  text="Warn on load when `types.plan.enabled` is true for one minor, remove at the next major. *P…"

alternative line=202 label="c" title="Rename the built-in"
  text="(`roadmap`, `outline`). *Pros:* keeps the slot. *Cons:* renames an unused type; the slot i…"

alternative line=205 label="d" title="This ADR."
  text="Remove it, document the custom-type fallback, decide the semver treatment explicitly."

question 1 line=215 title="Semver treatment"
  options=4 [a* b c d] resolved={line=217 date="2026-09-19" choice="c" note="The removal is the breaking change it technically is and rides the v2 line that ships the …"}

question 2 line=231 title="Sequencing against the API work"
  options=4 [a* b c d] resolved={line=233 date="2026-09-19" choice="a" note="with the v1 line untouched. The removal lands inside the `cmd/` swap, which ships as `v2.0…"}
